status: design-only; not activated or compiled in SAP
persistenceMode: custom operational persistence; no FI-AA/MM postings

Submit.guard: NEW -> SUBMITTED; apply ticket guards in behavior.md
Submit.determinations: Authenticated actor, UTC timestamp, status/feature fields and SLA lifecycle update; append event atomically.
Submit.scope: Authenticated requester owns this NEW ticket.

AssignTechnician.guard: SUBMITTED -> ASSIGNED; apply ticket guards in behavior.md
AssignTechnician.determinations: Authenticated actor, UTC timestamp, status/feature fields and SLA lifecycle update; append event atomically.
AssignTechnician.scope: Supervisor manages the ticket team; chosen technician must be eligible for that team.

StartWork.guard: ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS; apply ticket guards in behavior.md
StartWork.determinations: Authenticated actor, UTC timestamp, status/feature fields and SLA lifecycle update; append event atomically.
StartWork.scope: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

PutOnHold.guard: IN_PROGRESS -> WAITING; apply ticket guards in behavior.md
PutOnHold.determinations: Authenticated actor, UTC timestamp, status/feature fields and SLA lifecycle update; append event atomically.
PutOnHold.scope: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

Resume.guard: WAITING -> IN_PROGRESS; apply ticket guards in behavior.md
Resume.determinations: Authenticated actor, UTC timestamp, status/feature fields and SLA lifecycle update; append event atomically.
Resume.scope: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

Resolve.guard: IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED; apply ticket guards in behavior.md
Resolve.determinations: Authenticated actor, UTC timestamp, status/feature fields and SLA lifecycle update; append event atomically.
Resolve.scope: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

Close.guard: RESOLVED -> CLOSED; apply ticket guards in behavior.md
Close.determinations: Authenticated actor, UTC timestamp, status/feature fields and SLA lifecycle update; append event atomically.
Close.scope: Authenticated requester owns this RESOLVED ticket; CLOSED tickets cannot reopen in this MVP.

Reopen.guard: RESOLVED -> IN_PROGRESS; apply ticket guards in behavior.md
Reopen.determinations: Authenticated actor, UTC timestamp, status/feature fields and SLA lifecycle update; append event atomically.
Reopen.scope: Authenticated requester owns this RESOLVED ticket; CLOSED tickets cannot reopen in this MVP.

MakeAvailable.determinations: Derive current custody; close/create assignment intervals at the same instant; preserve custody during repair; append history.
MakeAvailable.scope: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

AssignAsset.determinations: Derive current custody; close/create assignment intervals at the same instant; preserve custody during repair; append history.

ReturnAsset.determinations: Derive current custody; close/create assignment intervals at the same instant; preserve custody during repair; append history.
ReturnAsset.scope: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

SendForRepair.guard: AVAILABLE or ASSIGNED -> IN_REPAIR; at most one open repair; matching ticket and technician
SendForRepair.determinations: Derive current custody; close/create assignment intervals at the same instant; preserve custody during repair; append history.
SendForRepair.scope: Technician has assigned linked work, or asset administrator controls the asset; preserve repair and parts invariants.

CompleteRepair.guard: IN_REPAIR -> ASSIGNED if current custody exists, otherwise AVAILABLE; no outstanding linked requests
CompleteRepair.determinations: Derive current custody; close/create assignment intervals at the same instant; preserve custody during repair; append history.
CompleteRepair.scope: Technician has assigned linked work, or asset administrator controls the asset; preserve repair and parts invariants.

DisposeAsset.determinations: Derive current custody; close/create assignment intervals at the same instant; preserve custody during repair; append history.
DisposeAsset.scope: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

ReceiveStock.determinations: Fixed decimal (15,3); EA whole units; recompute availability/status, pair transfers, retain all origin references; append immutable movement.
ReceiveStock.scope: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

ReserveStock.guard: positive available quantity; matching optional ticket/asset/open repair
ReserveStock.determinations: Fixed decimal (15,3); EA whole units; recompute availability/status, pair transfers, retain all origin references; append immutable movement.
ReserveStock.scope: Store officer controls location, or technician has assigned linked work; prevent oversubscription.

RequestPart.guard: IN_PROGRESS or WAITING ticket; matching open repair when affected asset exists; sufficient stock
RequestPart.determinations: Fixed decimal (15,3); EA whole units; recompute availability/status, pair transfers, retain all origin references; append immutable movement.
RequestPart.scope: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

TransferStock.guard: distinct locations of same material; source available quantity sufficient
TransferStock.determinations: Fixed decimal (15,3); EA whole units; recompute availability/status, pair transfers, retain all origin references; append immutable movement.
TransferStock.scope: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

ReturnStock.guard: original ISSUE belongs to this stock; cumulative returns <= original issued quantity
ReturnStock.determinations: Fixed decimal (15,3); EA whole units; recompute availability/status, pair transfers, retain all origin references; append immutable movement.
ReturnStock.scope: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

AdjustStock.guard: nonzero signed adjustment; resulting physical >= reserved >= 0; reason required
AdjustStock.determinations: Fixed decimal (15,3); EA whole units; recompute availability/status, pair transfers, retain all origin references; append immutable movement.
AdjustStock.scope: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

IssueReservation.guard: OPEN or PARTIAL; positive quantity <= unissued remainder; linked ticket/repair eligible
IssueReservation.determinations: Fixed decimal (15,3); EA whole units; recompute availability/status, pair transfers, retain all origin references; append immutable movement.
IssueReservation.scope: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

CancelReservation.guard: OPEN or PARTIAL; release only unissued remainder
CancelReservation.determinations: Fixed decimal (15,3); EA whole units; recompute availability/status, pair transfers, retain all origin references; append immutable movement.
CancelReservation.scope: Store officer controls stock location, or technician owns the linked part request; cancel only outstanding quantity.

CreateInventoryItem.guard: Unique material number; valid tracking mode/unit/location; equipment serials and quantity consistent; configured number range; existing receipt requires EQUIPMENT
CreateInventoryItem.determinations: Create equipment as shared Assets, or quantity parts as Stocks and opening movement; allocate UUIDs/numbers; bump catalogue root ETag.
CreateInventoryItem.scope: Create catalogue items and receive into permitted locations; equipment creates shared assets.

ReceiveEquipment.guard: Unique material number; valid tracking mode/unit/location; equipment serials and quantity consistent; configured number range; existing receipt requires EQUIPMENT
ReceiveEquipment.determinations: Create equipment as shared Assets, or quantity parts as Stocks and opening movement; allocate UUIDs/numbers; bump catalogue root ETag.
ReceiveEquipment.scope: Receive serialized equipment into permitted locations; backend allocates tags.

SaveSLAPolicies.scope: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

PreviewSLA.guard: Valid AsOf >= latest ticket change and <= 2100; authorized read
PreviewSLA.determinations: Evaluate a copy; no state, audit, locks or ETag changes.
PreviewSLA.scope: Technician reads assigned tickets, supervisor manages team tickets, manager reads all; only CheckSLA can write escalation history.

CheckSLA.guard: Authorized scoped ticket; active escalation rules; no new escalation on completed ticket
CheckSLA.determinations: Assess current time, escalate only above recorded level; update checked time; no external notifications in this phase.
CheckSLA.scope: Technician reads assigned tickets, supervisor manages team tickets, manager reads all; only CheckSLA can write escalation history.

ChangePriority.guard: Authorized supervisor; valid priority, policy and reason
ChangePriority.determinations: Snapshot selected policy; preserve elapsed time and pauses; append audit; never reset historical first response.
ChangePriority.scope: Supervisor manages the ticket team; chosen technician must be eligible for that team.

CreateTicket.guard: Authenticated requester; active category/subcategory/team/location; affected asset belongs to requester; required subject/description
CreateTicket.determinations: Generate UUID and number; NEW status; server actors and UTC times; snapshot routing/SLA and append Create history.
CreateTicket.scope: Requester must equal authenticated employee; use active configuration and assigned asset.
